invariants.statement: Single authoritative writer and schema isolation: catalog.* schema revokes PUBLIC privileges, enforces forced RLS across all 6 tables, uses pg_advisory_xact_lock, and keeps product_facts and product_state_history append-only.
Zero-float integer minor-unit monetary invariant: price_minor >= 0 integer, ISO 4217 currency ^[A-Z]{3}$, and currency_scale BETWEEN 0 AND 4.
Monotonic revisions and lifecycle transitions: fact_revision >= 1, version = fact_revision, and lifecycle draft -> approved -> stale|withdrawn with withdrawn terminal.

Contract and schema compatibility: 4 catalog schemas, 4 registered NATS/AsyncAPI subjects, LP11001-LP11005 ProblemDetails and NATS error parity, additive 1.1.0 compatibility, and major 2.0.0 fail-closed rejection.

Fail-closed read vertical slice: auth/tenant/session scope enforcement without cross-tenant existence disclosure, approved minor-unit fact resolution, draft/withdrawn/stale/unknown/ambiguous/version-mismatch refusals, timeout-as-unknown, and message_id deduplication.

Mutation reliability, outbox atomicity, idempotency replay and LP04003 mismatch rejection, LP04001 conflict rejection, bounded retry backoff and DLQ routing, operator-authorized replay, and fail-closed emergency pause.
Repository SOT, API traceability, error-code registry, and TDD traceability gates are green with zero errors and zero warnings.

controls_verified: PostgreSQL migration enforces REVOKE ALL FROM PUBLIC on catalog schema, all 6 tables, and all 4 trigger functions, plus ENABLE/FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY keyed to current_setting('app.tenant_id', true).

Read and mutation Postgres repository/store adapters bind tenant session context inside transactions and reject unauthenticated or cross-tenant/cross-session requests fail-closed without cross-tenant existence disclosure.

Sensitive credential and PII fields are redacted via redactSensitiveData, redactSensitiveText, sanitizeAuditMetadata, and computeRedactedPayloadSha256 prior to persistence, ProblemDetails/NATS error replies, and audit receipt emission.
DLQ replay is disabled by default and restricted to operator-authorized tenant-scoped invocations that preserve lineage and emit audit receipts on livepilot.v1.audit.receipt.append.
Emergency pause blocks catalog mutations and DLQ replay fail-closed with LP05004 (EMERGENCY_PAUSE_ACTIVE).

evidence_limitations: PostgreSQL live execution, runtime RLS policy enforcement, up/down migration execution, and concurrent transaction locking were verified via static SQL inspection, in-memory stores, and Postgres transaction adapter tests because no PostgreSQL server (psql/pg_isready absent) or running Docker daemon is available in this workspace.
NATS JetStream request/reply, pub/sub ordering, retry, and DLQ routing were exercised deterministically through InProcessNatsBus rather than an external NATS JetStream cluster.
Standalone tsc typechecking was not executed because tsc is not installed in PATH; TypeScript modules were executed directly via Node.js v26.12.1 native TypeScript support.
